title: Staggered spinner reveal and icon density adaptation for split/compound buttons
creator: Ava Rodriguez
description: Problem statement: Compound / split buttons that contain both a primary action and a trailing overflow/menu have inconsistent loading affordances across themes and densities. On medium and compact densities the spinner often overlaps icons or pushes layout; on light/dark themes the spinner contrast and motion are noisy. This ticket designs a staggered-reveal spinner pattern and an icon-density adaptation rule so: (1) spinners replace only the primary action affordance and reveal progressively to avoid layout shift, (2) trailing icon clusters densify/reflow subtly when space is constrained, and (3) color/contrast tokens for spinners are theme-aware and meet AA accessibility for most backgrounds.
acceptance_criteria: Staggered spinner reveals the primary action only (not the overflow chevron) with a 120ms fade-in, then a 220ms scale-in — verified in Figma prototypes and a light/dark token matrix.
Icon-density adaptation reduces icon spacing by up to 10% on compact surfaces and applies a micro-overlap fallback for icon-only clusters to preserve button size without clipping labels.
No layout jump > 4px when entering loading state measured with Storybook story harness (chromatic snapshot baseline).
Spinner and icon color tokens meet WCAG AA contrast against the button background in light and dark themes; documented token mappings added to the token spec.

Keyboard + assistive technology: loading spinner receives an aria-live="polite" update announcing 'processing' only once per action; 'escape' (Esc) key triggers cancel affordance when cancelable is enabled.
Engineering implementation accompanied by unit tests, e2e scenario in Playwright hitting compact/medium/comfortable sizes, and a rollout plan with canary flag in console-2026.04 release.
Design review approved and UX copy for the cancel affordance written and localized (en, fr, de) in the PRD.
Performance: spinner-heavy flows showed no >3% increase in main-thread work for button render path in perf flame graphs.
Documentation: Storybook stories and Design Tokens page updated with examples and migration notes.
Accessibility review completed and results attached in the comments with remediation steps (if any).

2026-03-05 — Mike (Product): Wants cancelable affordance to be opt-in via API and default off for existing customers to avoid behavioural regressions.
2026-03-07 — Design review: Accepted staggered reveal; requested an additional micro-interaction for chevron bounce when menu opens to signal separation from primary action.
2026-03-09 — Localization: Copy for 'Cancel' and 'Processing' prepared; noted character length in de/fr requires button min-width guardrails.
engineering_comments: 2026-03-04 — Kai: Drafted implementation plan: CSS transition for opacity/transform with prefers-reduced-motion respect; JS fallback for older browsers. Will introduce a compact density CSS token that adjusts --icon-gap by -10%.

2026-03-08 — Perf: Ran microbenchmarks; overlay approach reduces layout thrashing compared to replace-node approach. Need to ensure KV cache in runtime components unaffected.
2026-03-09 — QA: Added Playwright scenarios for Esc-key cancel path and for keyboard focus states while spinner is visible.
